criteria.description: Leads with how to win against this competitor and our differentiators that matter to the buyer — a sales tool, not a neutral comparison.
Acknowledges the competitor's genuine strengths and reframes them, rather than pretending they're bad.
Names buyer-felt, exploitable weaknesses (not cosmetic) the rep can surface in a deal.
Provides objection handling responses and/or discovery 'landmine' questions that surface the competitor's gaps.
Honestly states when we win vs. when to walk away, rather than implying we win every deal.
